host_scope: RTX 4060 Laptop GPU / sm_89 / WSL2 only

authority.owner_direction: Execute the next stage after the R3 ncu PASS and do not perform SHA verification.
authority.replication_disclosure: The original cross-day replication and the prepared same-day R2 replication were waived by the owner after Day-1. This reconnection must not be described as an independent or cross-day replication PASS.

inputs.baseline_selection: path A / pass 2 for all 11 requests
inputs.baseline_qualification: The inherited OP3 result records baseline_self_repeat_tokens=PASS for A1 versus A2. R4 reuses A2 token IDs and does not rerun the unchanged eager baseline.

dispatch.candidate_scope: decode Q=1, output_attentions=false, exact frozen BF16 sm_89 contract only
dispatch.miss_policy: transformers eager with an explicit fallback reason

length_bucket_adapter.reason: The locked Triton candidate specializes/autotunes on exact K, while full-attention K advances every decode token. Padding to a frozen correctness-covered upper bucket bounds compilation without changing the three candidate kernels.
length_bucket_adapter.sliding: K remains exactly 512 and is not padded
length_bucket_adapter.padding: K/V append BF16 zeros and the additive mask appends torch.finfo(torch.bfloat16).min; exact bucket hits use the original tensors.
length_bucket_adapter.prewarm: Run one untracked custom-op call for sliding K=512 and each full upper bucket before formal replay so compilation/autotune is excluded from request timing.
length_bucket_adapter.evidence_boundary: The adapter receives no isolated or ncu performance claim. Its deployment correctness is decided only by the full replay exact-token gate.

replay.schedule: one complete K3 path per request; archived qualified OP3 A2 is the token oracle
replay.eos_policy: record EOS but do not truncate
replay.kv_policy: fresh DynamicCache per request; no cache crosses request boundaries
